result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position by requiring up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and written deletion certification. However, it goes beyond the playbook by covering all Works and Confidential Information. Requiring Works to be returned within 30 days regardless of final payment may conflict with subsection (c), which conditions delivery and assignment of Works in progress on final payment, thereby altering unrelated commercial intent. The drafting is generally clear, but “Company data” should track any defined data term, and the scope and timing of deletion could be stated more precisely.
